description:
## Context

Swarm-manager currently has 5 main tabs: Backlog, Scenarios, Execution, Prompts, Settings. Initiatives are displayed only as small inline blue badges on backlog cards — no dedicated view, no rollup analytics, no filtering by initiative. The director team in prompt-manager will use initiatives to decide what to focus on, making a proper initiative-centric dashboard critical.

The plan is to move Settings to a gear icon in the header (dialog or side panel) and replace the Settings tab with a Dashboard page.

## Research Goals

1. **Finalize the dashboard layout with three sections:**
   - **Snapshot stats bar** (top, single row): Active items, In Progress, Blocked, Ready to Go, Completed — each clickable to filter the backlog page
   - **Initiative cards** (main, scrollable grid): Priority-sorted cards showing progress bar, status breakdown (ready/in-progress/blocked), next unblocked item, blocked summary, quick actions (View Items, Run Next)
   - **Needs Attention feed** (bottom, compact list): Failed executions, workshop rounds with unresolved decisions, items in needs_fixup status, pending prompt-manager decisions

2. **Design the initiative card layout:**
   - Title + priority (initiatives need a new priority field, 1-10 scale)
   - Progress bar with completion ratio (completed/total)
   - Colored status dots showing item distribution across states
   - "Next up" showing highest-priority unblocked item
   - Blocked summary (what's blocking progress)
   - Quick actions: View Items (navigates to backlog filtered by initiative), Run Next (queues next unblocked item)
   - Sorting: by priority, then by progress (least complete first)

3. **Design the settings relocation:**
   - Desktop: gear icon in header → opens dialog or slide-over panel
   - Mobile: gear icon in header or overflow menu
   - Settings content stays the same (theme, execution defaults, workshop, agent behavior, UI preferences)

4. **Design unassigned items treatment:**
   - How to surface backlog items not in any initiative
   - Small count/link vs. dedicated "Unassigned" section

5. **Assess new initiative fields needed:**
   - `priority` (1-10) — for card sorting and director team integration
   - `target_date` (optional) — for time-sensitive initiatives
   - Any other fields that would improve the dashboard experience

## Deliverables

- Dashboard wireframe/mockup specification
- Initiative card component specification
- Needs Attention feed data contract
- Settings relocation design
- Initiative schema changes needed

## Key Files

- Current layout: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/components/layout/MainLayout.tsx`
- Current tabs definition: lines 22-28 of MainLayout.tsx
- Initiative types: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/types/domain.ts` (lines 128-141)
- Initiative badge: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/components/backlog/initiative-badge.tsx`
- Settings page: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx`
- Initiative API: `scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog/handler.go` (initiative endpoints)
